description.value: Chen's Garden (operating as Chan's Garden) is a Chinese restaurant in New Westminster serving an extensive menu of Cantonese and Szechuan-inspired dishes, from Ginger Beef and Wonton Noodle Soup to stir-fried lamb and whole-category seafood selections. The restaurant offers indoor dine-in seating alongside a full online ordering system for pickup and delivery. With nearly 500 customer reviews, it is a well-established neighbourhood stop suited to refuelling a hungry touring cyclist.

address.value: 441 E Columbia St, New Westminster, BC V3L 3X4
